comparison.objective: Counterhold a puzzle cube and turn one layer a quarter-turn until it clicks into alignment; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Both test bimanual counterholding and controlled rotation. Candidate additionally requires recessed hex-key use, separate lock release and tightening, fine non-fixed adjustment, and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Puzzle layer must reach one clicked quarter-turn alignment; candidate must satisfy an operating envelope over two physical impacts and retain its setting.
comparison.reason: The shared rotation primitive is generic; fixed-detent alignment does not test dynamic damping adjustment.
